cardigan-eisteddfod-1176.research_focus: A 12th-century Welsh court gathering of bards and harpists at a newly built stone castle.
cardigan-eisteddfod-1176.scene: Inside a timber-and-stone castle hall, a bard with a crwth and a harpist play before a seated lord and Welsh nobles on benches. Rushes on the floor, banners hanging from the rafters.

liszt-lisztomania-berlin.research_focus: 1840s Berlin concert hall, a virtuoso pianist at a grand piano before an overwhelmed audience.
liszt-lisztomania-berlin.scene: A long-haired pianist in a tailcoat seen from the side at a grand piano on a hall stage, while women in the front rows swoon, wave handkerchiefs and one reaches for a dropped glove. Gaslit hall with gilded balconies.

jenny-lind-america-tour.research_focus: 1850 Castle Garden, New York, packed concert hall with a lone soprano on stage.
jenny-lind-america-tour.scene: A lone soprano in a full-skirted gown stands on a stage before a vast packed hall of top-hatted men and bonneted women in the 1850s. Gas chandeliers overhead, a banner-draped balcony, an orchestra behind her.

carnegie-hall-opens.research_focus: Carnegie Hall's main auditorium in 1891: tiered boxes, a conductor on the podium.
carnegie-hall-opens.scene: The new tiered auditorium of a New York concert hall filled with formally dressed 1890s patrons, an orchestra on stage and a conductor with raised baton seen from behind. Ornate boxes and curved tiers rising to the ceiling.

first-promenade-concert.research_focus: 1895 Queen's Hall, London: standing promenaders on the floor, orchestra on stage, Edwardian dress.
first-promenade-concert.scene: A Victorian London concert hall where ordinary people stand and stroll casually on the open floor in front of an orchestra, while a conductor leads from the podium. Palms in pots at the stage edge.

mahler-symphony-of-a-thousand.research_focus: 1910 Munich exhibition hall: enormous choir and orchestra on tiered stage, conductor facing them.
mahler-symphony-of-a-thousand.scene: A huge hall where hundreds of choristers in tiers rise behind a large orchestra, with a slight conductor in a tailcoat on the podium seen from the audience side. An organ rises behind the choir.

hollywood-bowl-first-season.research_focus: 1922 Hollywood Bowl: natural hillside amphitheatre, benches on slope, small orchestra, open air.
hollywood-bowl-first-season.scene: A natural hollow in dry California hills where audiences sit on simple wooden benches up the slope at dusk, facing a small orchestra on a plain stage. Oak trees and scrub hills behind, early 1920s clothing.

benny-goodman-carnegie-hall.research_focus: 1938 swing band on a concert hall stage: clarinet, brass section, rhythm section, integrated lineup.
benny-goodman-carnegie-hall.scene: A swing band on a classical concert hall stage, a clarinettist at the front with the brass and a drummer behind, wearing 1930s tuxedos. The formal audience in the tiers leans forward and some tap their feet.

marian-anderson-lincoln-memorial.research_focus: Easter 1939: open-air crowd on the National Mall before the Lincoln Memorial steps, singer at microphones.
marian-anderson-lincoln-memorial.scene: Seen from within the crowd, a vast gathering of people in 1930s hats and coats stretches along a long reflecting pool toward the steps of a columned marble memorial, where a small figure in a long coat stands at a bank of microphones.

moondog-coronation-ball.research_focus: 1952 Cleveland arena overflowing with young people; a rhythm and blues dance gone wrong.
moondog-coronation-ball.scene: A packed 1950s indoor arena where young dancers crowd the floor and a saxophone player is on the stage, while a throng pushes through the doors at the back. A radio microphone stands on a small stand.

first-newport-jazz-festival.research_focus: 1954 Newport, Rhode Island: open-air jazz on a casino lawn by the sea, deck chairs, a small band on a tent stage.
first-newport-jazz-festival.scene: A seaside lawn in front of a grand shingle-style building, where listeners in deck chairs and blankets face a small bandstand under a canvas awning, with a double bass and a trumpet. Sailboats on the water behind.

first-glastonbury-festival.research_focus: 1970 Worthy Farm, Somerset: a small pyramid-style stage in a field, a few thousand hippies, cows, tents.
first-glastonbury-festival.scene: A small makeshift stage with a small lit pyramid-shaped canopy in an English dairy field at dusk, a few thousand long-haired people sitting on the grass among canvas tents, and cows grazing at the field's edge.

the-band-last-waltz.research_focus: Winterland Ballroom, San Francisco 1976: stage set with chandeliers, empty or with silhouetted musicians, instruments.
the-band-last-waltz.scene: An old ballroom stage dressed with large theatrical chandeliers and draped backdrops, a drum kit, organ and guitars on stands, and silhouetted musicians seen from far back in the hall, with a film camera on a crane in the foreground.

simon-garfunkel-central-park.research_focus: 1981 Great Lawn, Central Park: a gigantic crowd on grass facing a distant stage, with the city skyline behind.
simon-garfunkel-central-park.scene: A vast crowd of hundreds of thousands seen from behind spread over a huge grassy lawn, facing a tiny distant stage, with the skyline of Manhattan towers rising beyond the trees at evening.

three-tenors-rome.research_focus: Baths of Caracalla, Rome: ruined brick walls of the ancient baths as a stage backdrop, formal audience.
three-tenors-rome.scene: A great open-air stage against the towering ruined brick walls of ancient Roman baths, with three silhouetted men in formal wear standing in a row and an orchestra beside them. A seated audience in evening dress in front, the night sky above.

freddie-mercury-tribute-concert.research_focus: Wembley Stadium 1992: huge crowd, a stage with a lone microphone stand, raised hands.
freddie-mercury-tribute-concert.scene: A vast football stadium full of people with their arms raised, seen from the stage looking out, and a single microphone stand at the front of the stage with a spotlight on it and nobody standing at it.

first-coachella-festival.research_focus: October 1999 Empire Polo Club, Indio: a modest stage on a polo field, palm trees, desert mountains, a thin crowd.
first-coachella-festival.scene: A polo field in the desert with a modest stage and a small thin crowd of festival-goers on the dry grass, with rows of date palms and bare desert mountains behind under a huge sky.

concert-for-new-york-city.research_focus: Madison Square Garden 2001: a packed arena with rescue workers in uniform in the audience, flags.
concert-for-new-york-city.scene: The interior of a large round arena filled with the audience, many in firefighter and police uniforms and helmets, holding up small flags toward a lit stage, with a large flag hanging from the ceiling.

live-8-concerts.research_focus: 2005 Hyde Park, London: massive outdoor crowd, a big stage, white wristbands, city landmarks.
live-8-concerts.scene: A huge crowd in a London park seen from behind, many wearing wristbands and holding their hands in the air toward a massive stage with large video screens, under an overcast summer sky.

tupac-hologram-coachella.research_focus: 2012 Coachella: a glowing projected figure on stage against a festival crowd, no identifiable likeness.
tupac-hologram-coachella.scene: A desert festival stage at night where a shimmering, ghostly projected figure with a bare torso glows in a beam of light, seen only from behind, in front of a huge crowd and tall palm trees at the side.

beychella-coachella.research_focus: 2018 Coachella: marching-band and step-team spectacle, tiered stage, many performers in matching outfits.
beychella-coachella.scene: A towering tiered stage filled with dozens of performers in matching collegiate-style outfits, a marching band with drums and brass and step dancers in rows, seen from the crowd with a vast festival crowd and desert mountains behind.

one-world-together-at-home.research_focus: April 2020: someone performing at home on a couch or in a living room for a livestream, home camera setup.
one-world-together-at-home.scene: A cosy living room where a performer seen from behind sits on a sofa with an acoustic guitar facing a phone on a small tripod, with a lamp, bookshelves and a window to an empty street in the background. No people other than the performer.

taylor-swift-eras-tour-begins.research_focus: March 2023 stadium: huge stage with a long runway, sparkling crowd of fans in costume, friendship bracelets.
taylor-swift-eras-tour-begins.scene: A large domed stadium packed to the roof with sparkling fans, many wearing sequins and holding up arms covered in beaded friendship bracelets, facing a huge stage with a long runway and giant video walls. No performers visible.
